products_publish_completeness.name: products_publish_completeness
products_publish_completeness.value: "products"."status" <> 'published' or ("products"."name_th" <> '' and "products"."name_en" <> '' and "products"."body_th" is not null and "products"."body_en" is not null)

coupons_single_value_shape.name: coupons_single_value_shape
coupons_single_value_shape.value:
(
        ("coupons"."kind" = 'percent' and "coupons"."value_percent" between 1 and 100 and "coupons"."value_satang" is null)
        or
        ("coupons"."kind" = 'fixed' and "coupons"."value_satang" > 0 and "coupons"."value_percent" is null)
      )

coupons_window_order.name: coupons_window_order
coupons_window_order.value: "coupons"."starts_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" >= "coupons"."starts_at"

payments_verified_has_trans_ref.name: payments_verified_has_trans_ref
payments_verified_has_trans_ref.value: "payments"."status" <> 'verified' or "payments"."trans_ref" is not null or "payments"."verified_via" is not null

banners_window_order.name: banners_window_order
banners_window_order.value: "banners"."starts_at" is null or "banners"."ends_at" is null or "banners"."ends_at" >= "banners"."starts_at"

events_publish_completeness.name: events_publish_completeness
events_publish_completeness.value: "events"."status" <> 'published' or ("events"."title_th" <> '' and "events"."title_en" <> '' and "events"."description_th" is not null and "events"."description_en" is not null)

news_posts_publish_completeness.name: news_posts_publish_completeness
news_posts_publish_completeness.value: "news_posts"."status" <> 'published' or ("news_posts"."title_th" <> '' and "news_posts"."title_en" <> '' and "news_posts"."body_th" is not null and "news_posts"."body_en" is not null)

pages_publish_completeness.name: pages_publish_completeness
pages_publish_completeness.value: "pages"."status" <> 'published' or ("pages"."title_th" <> '' and "pages"."title_en" <> '' and "pages"."body_th" is not null and "pages"."body_en" is not null)
